title: Cut / trim
description: Keep a stretch of the input: from a start to an end, or only the first or the last seconds, once or repeated.

inputs.name: region
inputs.title: Region in
inputs.description: A region (the joins of a loop) to process instead of audio. The result stays a region: it never reaches an audio input, only a region-merge block turns it back into audio.

outputs.name: region
outputs.title: Loop seam
outputs.description: The processed region. Connect it to another effect or to a region-merge block.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the input on unchanged.

parameters.name: start
parameters.doc: Where the kept stretch starts, in seconds from the start of the input (empty: the start).

parameters.name: end
parameters.doc: Where the kept stretch ends, in seconds (empty: the end of the input).

parameters.name: first
parameters.doc: Keep only the first seconds of the input. Wins over start and end.

parameters.name: last
parameters.doc: Keep only the last seconds of the input. Wins over start and end, after first.

parameters.name: loop
parameters.doc: On repeats the kept stretch until the block ends.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
